entry_points.text: Rebuild driver-visible features by clearing accumulator then walking full space in 32b steps selecting each word and merging into 64b entries.

exports.text: Program features via selector/value halves; read generation/status bytes; select queue then reset/enable; assign config vector with readback; common area also holds admin count, notif-data and MSI-X.
Mark or clear per-queue broken flag with ordered writes observed via single read elsewhere.
Check parts support; resolve PF from VF, derive VF index, build parts-set for member VF+1 with caller scatter and dispatch via admin path, failing on missing PF or bad index.

hazards.text: Debug corruption reports via device error then traps unconditionally; production reports similarly but marks queue permanently broken for graceful failure.

invariants.text: Allow only 1/2/4/8B config access with endian convert, splitting 8B into two 4B MMIO; other widths or overruns past recorded length are programming errors; generation/status reads delegate to MMIO.

Observe split/packed indices, flags and lengths via single atomic plus endian; order writes, reads and events with virt versus DMA barriers by weak mode; event test uses wrap-safe u16; indirect needs host plus multi-seg plus space; premapped reuse else phys or DMA map with OOM; split unmap skips untracked or bypassed else direction from write flag; indirect alloc avoids highmem with co-alloc and pre-chain; descriptor install stores device order plus host extra.

Reclaim chains by clearing token, crediting slots and splicing unordered tails; unused scan withdraws shadow avail with full scan proving free equals size; reset clears flags, indices and events then re-inits; debug add-kick timing warns past a tenth second else no-op; split ops forward-declared.
Relies on external alloc, list, spinlock, PCI, scatterlist, barrier, byte IO, phys, print, bug, build-bug, idr, min, memcpy, kmsan and dev-error helpers owned elsewhere.

locks.text: Debug enforces exclusive queue use via enter and exit markers with callsite record, reentry panic, exit assert and clear; release is no-op; every inspect and mutate path pairs markers including failures.

state_machines.text: Never set zero via normal setter; reset writes zero then polls with millisecond sleeps flushing writes and interrupts, then admin cleanup and callback flush; driver-ok also activates admin; admin is inert unless negotiated with init on activation; out-of-range, zero via setter and bad widths trap and polls can stall.

Discovery enables all queues irreversibly; data notify writes derived 32b payload to private address; vector selection delegates; disable needs ring-reset, asserts reset, detaches IRQ, optionally marks broken, waits exclusive vector via irq sync and sets flag; re-enable only with flag plus clear hardware, reactivates with saved vector, rejoins IRQ if callback, clears broken, enables hardware and clears flag; list add/remove uses irq-saving spinlock; re-enable without reset or with hardware set fails busy and disable without feature reports unsupported.

Split add validates token, rejects broken, picks indirect or inline, accounts space, maps out then in, publishes head under barrier, forces kick near u16 saturation and unwinds on fail with EIO, ENOSPC or ENOMEM; kick snapshots range, clears pending and uses event-index compare or no-notify test; poll compares consumed to device used with ordered also reporting cached batch; unordered get declines when broken or empty, barriers, masks index, validates id and token, detaches, advances, publishes event and invalidates timing; ordered matches cache length; enable publishes consumed position, delayed publishes three quarters ahead reporting pending; resize installs replacement on success else leaves reset with ENOMEM; malformed rings trigger bug handling.

Packed indirect table allocation and extra unmapping support submission; ordered direct lays segments sequentially with head identifier, accumulates input length, inverts phase and wrap on wrap, publishes head last behind barrier, updates counts, restoring phase and wrap while unpublishing and unmapping on fail.

structs.text: Uses v1/data/reset/admin/SRIOV features; cap/mode/object/metadata/parts opcodes; self/SRIOV groups; parts bit/bitmap; SHM BAR/off/len halves; direct byte IO; finalize needs v1 and length for data/reset/admin, SRIOV only if offered+ext cap; self list fits u64 and needs parts bit; create=parts+get/set+nonzero max, destroy=parts, metadata=size, parts=all, all need PF+valid VF, member VF+1, pooled IDs, errno; SHM walks vendor caps by type/id, checks len/BAR, rejects wrap/overflow, reports addr/len; admin cmd has opcode/group/member/data/result/completion; queue has index/reset/cb/notif/vector.

Avail event follows used entries, used event at avail[size]; split uses NEXT, INDIRECT and NO_INTERRUPT with positive multiple length; packed uses AVAIL, USED, WRITE, chaining and indirect with WRAP_CTR masked; indirect reclaim validates length and marker, unmaps only if enabled; ordered reclaim uses UINT_MAX-empty cache advancing by freed; disable sets shadow marker with zero or flags publish; packed indirect maps all segments into one slot with barrier publish and phase advance unwinding on fail; unordered direct falls back from indirect only on ENOMEM, chains except last and publishes head last; indirect extra follows descriptors with count length/size.

Two config tables share handlers except device byte access disabled in nodevice; split state pairs token with indirect and inbound, packed adds list, tail and skipped, extra keeps addr, len, flags and succ; split store adds shadow avail, state/extra, DMA/size and align/shrink; packed store adds size, desc/event areas, wrap/flags/next, shadow events, state/extra and DMA/sizes; central queue adds DMA/barrier/broken/indirect/event flags, layout, heads, batch, counts, positions, cursor, hint, union, notify, owner and debug; ops abstracts add/get/kick/cb/detach/poll/resize/reset; layout is split/packed with/without in-order.
